verdict.rationale: A government immigration-administration service could plausibly publish bulk statistics or dataset extracts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a keyless JavaScript shell with every transaction behind an account, and a Cloudflare-challenged ministry site. Nothing documents any bulk download, dataset, or extract offering.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
